evals.prompt: The /products page in app/products renders 10,000 rows and typing in the filter is sluggish. Optimize its rendering.
evals.expected_output: Rendering overhead is profiles, dynamic loading or virtualization added, re-renders eliminated.
expectations: The bottleneck is identified (all 10,000 rows rendered and re-rendered on each keystroke) before changing code
The list is virtualized or paginated, and the heavy ChartPanel is loaded with next/dynamic or otherwise deferred
Unnecessary re-renders are removed (memoized rows and callbacks, deferred or transitioned filtering)
The change states how the improvement is verified (React Profiler or INP/LCP measurement)
